scenario.wizard.s1.header: ECOS Top-Level Design · Scenario Elements & Tactical Objectives
scenario.wizard.s1.desc: Starting from the scenario's physical characteristics, responsible department, safety goals and assurance budget, define the core value boundary and tactical focus of this business scenario in digital space.
scenario.wizard.s1.namePlaceholder: e.g. 2026 Cross-border Duty Hours Compliance Reconciliation Center
scenario.wizard.s1.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Reduce flight duty reconciliation time by 90% via LLM inference
scenario.wizard.s1.descPlaceholder: Describe the involved departments, compliance background, and specific zero-trust data security risks to be prevented.
scenario.wizard.s2.desc: Connect raw physical data tables and primary-replica change streams. This data is the absolute foundation for scenario ontology evolution and real-time analytics.
scenario.wizard.s2.label: Select physical tables & data sources to integrate
scenario.wizard.s3.desc: Abstract raw physical tables into business objects in a virtual alignment space. The ontology hides relational storage details, enabling agents to perform commonsense reasoning directly.
scenario.wizard.s3.label: Select federated logical ontology entities to connect
scenario.wizard.s4.header: ECOS Compliance Rule & Prior Knowledge Layer
scenario.wizard.s4.desc: Import industry-standard compliance criteria, regulations, or emergency plans. These form the core rule constraints for agent logic, reasoning, and compliance review.
scenario.wizard.s4.label: Select compliance knowledge bases to inject into this scenario
scenario.wizard.s5.desc: Assign backend LLM reasoning engines and analytical agents to this scenario. They will collaboratively handle auto-scheduling, financial discrepancy review, and sensitive privilege escalation alerts.
scenario.wizard.s5.label: Assign LLMs and decision-making agents
scenario.wizard.s6.desc: Connect end-user operational interfaces, low-code dashboards, and business decision flows. This is the final HMI window for operations directors, DPOs, and dispatchers.
scenario.wizard.s6.label: Bind frontend business display systems & visual dashboards
scenario.wizard.s7.header: ECOS Zero-Trust Cascading Security Isolation Domain
scenario.wizard.s7.desc: Mount hard-constraint fine-grained security rules. Sensitive PII (e.g. captain's salary, social security) is forcibly masked at interception hooks; non-whitelisted IPs are auto-sandboxed; multi-tier director sign-off is enforced.
scenario.wizard.s7.label: Select cascading security isolation domain rules & interception nets

scenario.metrics.radarTitle: Monthly Security Interception Audit Categories (Blocked Policy Violations)
scenario.metrics.radarSource: * Data exported in real time and aggregated by the underlying security audit controller `app.get('/api/security/audit-logs')`.
scenario.metrics.trendFootnote: * After the dual-engine automated reconciliation signature flow, the average bad-weather dispatch duration on peak season dropped from 45 minutes to a ~3.5-second scale.
scenario.metrics.execDataFlow: 1. Data flow is healthy: this month the main reconciliation chain (Doris cleaned wide table ds_flights_clean to the ontology logical AviationFlight) held mapping consistency at an excellent 98%. No write anomalies caused by logic contract breakage.
scenario.metrics.execSecurity: 2. Security boundary holds: with the mandatory zero-trust gr-pii and gr-approval blocking rules, the plaintext pilot SSN and payroll records that an external maintenance contractor (EXTERNAL_CONTRACTOR) tried to brute-force export from a non-whitelisted gateway were 100% masked by the RUST shield layer.
scenario.metrics.execOptimization: 3. To optimize: the eVTOL low-altitude scenario is still in DRAFT. Next, build a physical survey/remote-sensing table for the new eVTOL UAVs and design the many-to-many ontology alignment between the City Meteo Entity (MeteoEntity) and the Airport Vertiport Stand (Vertiport).
